bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a bias-corrected Multilevel Regression and Post-Stratification (MrP) model on unrepresentative social media samples by comparing state-level election predictions against high-quality random surveys and polling aggregators.

Comparing LLM-generated labels of Twitter users' voting behaviors and political preferences against human annotations using a Bayesian Poisson mixture-model to identify systematic disagreements (e.g., predicting 'Democrats stay home' behavior).

Comparing age demographic classifications generated by LLMs from social media profiles against human annotations using a bipartite network agreement model to find systematic classification biases (e.g., middle-aged confusion and old-age bias).
Evaluating discrepancies in household income classifications of Twitter users between LLMs and human annotators to identify systematic tendencies, such as predicting higher income.
Comparing educational attainment classifications generated by LLMs against human annotations to identify systematic disagreements, such as a bias towards predicting higher education levels.
